segments.ja526:1.3: Ehi niḷinike [niḷike (sī. syā. pī.), evamuparipi] gaccha, taṃ me brāhmaṇamānaya”.
segments.ja526:3.1: “Phītaṃ janapadaṃ gantvā, hatthinā ca rathena ca;
segments.ja526:6.3: Maññe no aggiṃ hāpeti, isisiṅgo mahiddhiko”.
segments.ja526:8.1: “Assamassa ca sā dvāre, geṇḍukenassa [bheṇḍukenassa (sī. pī.)] kīḷati;
segments.ja526:10.1: “Ambho ko nāma so rukkho, yassa tevaṃgataṃ phalaṃ;
segments.ja526:10.3: Dūrepi khittaṃ pacceti, na taṃ ohāya gacchati”.
segments.ja526:11.3: Bahavo [pabbate (sī.)] tādisā rukkhā, yassa tevaṃgataṃ phalaṃ;
segments.ja526:11.5: Dūrepi khittaṃ pacceti, na maṃ ohāya gacchati”.
segments.ja526:12.1: “Etū [etu (sī. syā. ka.)] bhavaṃ assamimaṃ adetu, pajjañca bhakkhañca paṭiccha dammi;
segments.ja526:12.3: Idamāsanaṃ atra bhavaṃ nisīdatu, ito bhavaṃ mūlaphalāni bhuñjatu”[khādatu (sī.)].
segments.ja526:13.3: Akkhāhi me pucchito etamatthaṃ, kose nu te uttamaṅgaṃ paviṭṭhaṃ”.
segments.ja526:14.1: “Ahaṃ vane mūlaphalesanaṃ caraṃ, āsādayiṃ [assādayiṃ (ka.)] acchaṃ sughorarūpaṃ;
segments.ja526:14.3: So maṃ patitvā sahasājjhapatto, panujja maṃ abbahi [abbuhi (syā. ka.)] uttamaṅgaṃ.
segments.ja526:15.1: “Svāyaṃ vaṇo khajjati kaṇḍuvāyati, sabbañca kālaṃ na labhāmi sātaṃ;
segments.ja526:15.3: Paho bhavaṃ kaṇḍumimaṃ vinetuṃ, kurutaṃ bhavaṃ yācito brāhmaṇatthaṃ”.
segments.ja526:16.1: “Gambhīrarūpo te vaṇo salohito, apūtiko vaṇagandho [pakkagandho (sī.), pannagandho (syā. pī.)] mahā ca;
segments.ja526:16.3: Karomi te kiñci kasāyayogaṃ, yathā bhavaṃ paramasukhī bhaveyya”.
segments.ja526:17.1: “Na mantayogā na kasāyayogā, na osadhā brahmacāri [brahmacārī (sī. syā. pī.)] kamanti;
segments.ja526:17.3: Ghaṭṭe mudukena [yaṃ te mudu tena (sī.), yaṃ te mudū tena (pī.)] vinehi kaṇḍuṃ [kaṇḍukaṃ (pī.)], yathā ahaṃ paramasukhī bhaveyyaṃ”.
segments.ja526:18.1: “Ito nu bhoto katamena assamo, kacci bhavaṃ abhiramasi [abhiramasī (pī.)] araññe;
segments.ja526:18.3: Kacci nu te [kacci te (pī.)] mūlaphalaṃ pahūtaṃ, kacci bhavantaṃ na vihiṃsanti vāḷā”.
segments.ja526:19.1: “Ito ujuṃ uttarāyaṃ disāyaṃ, khemānadī himavatā pabhāvī [pabhāti (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja526:19.3: Tassā tīre assamo mayha rammo, aho bhavaṃ assamaṃ mayhaṃ passe.
segments.ja526:20.1: “Ambā ca sālā tilakā ca jambuyo, uddālakā pāṭaliyo ca phullā;
segments.ja526:20.3: Samantato kimpurisābhigītaṃ, aho bhavaṃ assamaṃ mayhaṃ passe.
segments.ja526:21.1: “Tālā ca mūlā ca phalā ca mettha, vaṇṇena gandhena upetarūpaṃ;
segments.ja526:21.3: Taṃ bhūmibhāgehi upetarūpaṃ, aho bhavaṃ assamaṃ mayhaṃ passe.
segments.ja526:22.1: “Phalā ca mūlā ca pahūtamettha, vaṇṇena gandhena rasenupetā;
segments.ja526:22.3: Āyanti ca luddakā taṃ padesaṃ, mā me tato mūlaphalaṃ ahāsuṃ”.
segments.ja526:23.1: “Pitā mamaṃ mūlaphalesanaṃ gato, idāni āgacchati sāyakāle;
segments.ja526:23.3: Ubhova gacchāmase assamaṃ taṃ, yāva pitā mūlaphalato etu”.
segments.ja526:24.1: “Aññe bahū isayo sādhurūpā, rājīsayo anumagge vasanti;
segments.ja526:24.3: Te yeva pucchesi mamassamaṃ taṃ, te taṃ nayissanti mamaṃ sakāse”.
segments.ja526:25.1: “Na te kaṭṭhāni bhinnāni, na te udakamābhataṃ;
segments.ja526:25.3: Aggīpi te na hāpito [hāsito (sī. syā.)], kiṃ nu mandova jhāyasi.
segments.ja526:26.1: “Bhinnāni kaṭṭhāni huto ca aggi, tapanīpi te samitā brahmacārī [brahmacāri (?)];
segments.ja526:26.3: Pīṭhañca mayhaṃ udakañca hoti, ramasi tuvaṃ [tvaṃ (sī.)] brahmabhūto puratthā.
segments.ja526:27.3: Na me tuvaṃ ālapasī mamajja, naṭṭhaṃ nu kiṃ cetasikañca dukkhaṃ”.
segments.ja526:29.3: Dve yamā [dve passa (sī.), dvāssa (pī.)] gaṇḍā uresu jātā, suvaṇṇatindukanibhā [suvaṇṇapindūpanibhā (sī.), suvaṇṇatiṇḍusannibhā (syā.), sovannapiṇḍūpanibhā (pī.)] pabhassarā.
segments.ja526:30.1: “Mukhañca tassa bhusadassaneyyaṃ, kaṇṇesu lambanti ca kuñcitaggā;
segments.ja526:30.3: Te jotare carato māṇavassa, suttañca yaṃ saṃyamanaṃ jaṭānaṃ.
segments.ja526:31.1: “Aññā ca tassa saṃyamāni [saṃyamanī (sī. pī.)] catasso, nīlā pītā [nīlāpi tā (pī.)] lohitikā [lohitakā (syā. pī. ka.)] ca setā;
segments.ja526:31.3: Tā piṃsare [saṃsare (sī. syā.)] carato māṇavassa, tiriṭi [cirīṭi (sī. pī.)] saṅghāriva pāvusamhi.
segments.ja526:32.1: “Na mikhalaṃ muñjamayaṃ dhāreti, na santhare [santace (sī.), santacaṃ (pī.), santare (ka.)] no pana pabbajassa;
segments.ja526:32.3: Tā jotare jaghanantare [jaghanavare (sī. pī.)] vilaggā, sateratā vijjurivantalikkhe.
segments.ja526:33.3: Aghaṭṭitā niccakīḷaṃ karonti, haṃ tāta kiṃrukkhaphalāni tāni.
segments.ja526:34.1: “Jaṭā ca tassa bhusadassaneyyā, parosataṃ vellitaggā sugandhā;
segments.ja526:34.3: Dvedhā siro sādhu vibhattarūpo, aho nu kho mayha tathā jaṭāssu.
segments.ja526:35.1: “Yadā ca so pakirati tā jaṭāyo, vaṇṇena gandhena upetarūpā;
segments.ja526:35.3: Nīluppalaṃ vātasameritaṃva, tatheva saṃvāti panassamo ayaṃ.
segments.ja526:36.1: “Paṅko ca tassa bhusadassaneyyo, netādiso yādiso mayhaṃ kāye [kāyo (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja526:36.3: So vāyatī erito mālutena, vanaṃ yathā aggagimhe suphullaṃ.
segments.ja526:37.1: “Nihanti so rukkhaphalaṃ pathabyā, sucittarūpaṃ ruciraṃ dassaneyyaṃ;
segments.ja526:37.3: Khittañca tassa punareti hatthaṃ, haṃ tāta kiṃrukkhaphalaṃ nu kho taṃ.
segments.ja526:38.1: “Dantā ca tassa bhusadassaneyyā, suddhā samā saṅkhavarūpapannā;
segments.ja526:38.3: Mano pasādenti vivariyamānā, na hi [na ha (sī. pī.)] nūna so sākamakhādi tehi.
segments.ja526:39.1: “Akakkasaṃ aggaḷitaṃ muhuṃ muduṃ, ujuṃ anuddhataṃ acapalamassa bhāsitaṃ;
segments.ja526:39.3: Rudaṃ manuññaṃ karavīkasussaraṃ, hadayaṅgamaṃ rañjayateva me mano.
segments.ja526:40.1: “Bindussaro nātivisaṭṭhavākyo [nātivissaṭṭhavākyo (sī. syā. pī.)], na nūna sajjhāyamatippayutto;
segments.ja526:40.3: Icchāmi bho [kho (sī. syā. pī.)] taṃ punadeva daṭṭhuṃ, mitto hi [mittaṃ hi (sī. syā. pī.)] me māṇavohu [māṇavāhu (sī. syā.), māṇavāhū (pī.)] puratthā.
segments.ja526:41.1: “Susandhi sabbattha vimaṭṭhimaṃ vaṇaṃ, puthū [puthuṃ (pī.), puthu (ka.)] sujātaṃ kharapattasannibhaṃ;
segments.ja526:41.3: Teneva maṃ uttariyāna māṇavo, vivaritaṃ ūruṃ jaghanena pīḷayi.
segments.ja526:43.1: “Akakkasaṅgo na ca dīghalomo, nakhāssa dīghā api lohitaggā;
segments.ja526:43.3: Mudūhi bāhāhi palissajanto, kalyāṇarūpo ramayaṃ [ramayhaṃ (ka.)] upaṭṭhahi.
segments.ja526:44.3: Hatthā mudū tehi maṃ saṃphusitvā, ito gato tena maṃ dahanti tāta.
segments.ja526:45.1: “Na nūna [na ha nūna (sī. pī.)] so khārividhaṃ ahāsi, na nūna so kaṭṭhāni sayaṃ abhañji;
segments.ja526:45.3: Na nūna so hanti dume kuṭhāriyā [kudhāriyā (ka.)], na hissa [na pissa (sī. syā. pī.)] hatthesu khilāni atthi.
segments.ja526:46.1: “Accho ca kho tassa vaṇaṃ akāsi, so maṃbravi sukhitaṃ maṃ karohi;
segments.ja526:46.3: Tāhaṃ kariṃ tena mamāsi sokhyaṃ, so cabravi sukhitosmīti brahme.
segments.ja526:47.1: “Ayañca te māluvapaṇṇasanthatā, vikiṇṇarūpāva mayā ca tena ca;
segments.ja526:47.3: Kilantarūpā udake ramitvā, punappunaṃ paṇṇakuṭiṃ vajāma.
segments.ja526:48.1: “Na majja mantā paṭibhanti tāta, na aggihuttaṃ napi yaññatantaṃ [yaññatantraṃ (sī.), yaññaṃ tatra (pī. ka.), yaññatatra (syā.)];
segments.ja526:48.3: Na cāpi te mūlaphalāni bhuñje, yāva na passāmi taṃ brahmacāriṃ.
segments.ja526:49.1: “Addhā pajānāsi tuvampi tāta, yassaṃ disaṃ [disāyaṃ (syā. pī. ka.)] vasate brahmacārī;
segments.ja526:49.3: Taṃ maṃ disaṃ pāpaya tāta khippaṃ, mā te ahaṃ amarimassamamhi.
segments.ja526:50.1: “Vicitraphullaṃ [vicitrapupphaṃ (sī. pī.)] hi vanaṃ sutaṃ mayā, dijābhighuṭṭhaṃ dijasaṅghasevitaṃ;
segments.ja526:50.3: Taṃ maṃ vanaṃ pāpaya tāta khippaṃ, purā te pāṇaṃ vijahāmi assame”.
segments.ja526:52.1: “Bhavanti mittāni atho na honti, ñātīsu mittesu karonti pemaṃ;
segments.ja526:52.3: Ayañca jammo kissa vā niviṭṭho, yo neva jānāti kutomhi āgato.
segments.ja526:53.3: Sveva mitto [sā ca metti (pī.)] asaṃgantu, asaṃvāsena jīrati.
segments.ja526:54.1: “Sace tuvaṃ dakkhasi brahmacāriṃ, sace tuvaṃ sallape [sallapi (sī.)] brahmacārinā;
segments.ja526:54.3: Sampannasassaṃva mahodakena, tapoguṇaṃ khippamimaṃ pahissasi [pahassasi (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja526:55.1: “Punapi [punappi (pī.)] ce dakkhasi brahmacāriṃ, punapi [punappi (pī.)] ce sallape brahmacārinā;
segments.ja526:56.3: Na tāni sevetha naro sapañño, āsajja naṃ nassati brahmacārī”ti.
